{{Top|leg}}
'''Tracker scouts''' were a specialized division of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. Tracker scouts were deployed alongside [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] to apprehend [[Cheryl Trinja]], a naturally-powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].
